name: PlugBrug
author: Bram van Oploo
description: The missing bridge between the official plugin Marketplace and your system. Manage your plugins directly from the browser Marketplace. Install, remove, update and place plugins. Install the accompanying extension for your Firefox- or CHromium-based browser and off you go!

barWidget.description: Bar icon that lights up while a browser tab is open on an installable plugin page; left click opens a menu to install, uninstall, update, or move that plugin's bar icon; right click opens settings with the plugin-update poll, an update-now action, the unverified-versions toggle, and the browser-store links, with a counter badge while plugins have updates
